name: bash-safety-guard
description: Fail-closed PreToolUse bash guard for Claude Code: blocks destructive production-data operations (DROP/TRUNCATE/DELETE FROM, convex import --replace/--prod, prisma/drizzle reset, redis flush, dynamo/S3 deletes), credential exfiltration (secret files/tokens sent off-box or piped to paste/tunnel sinks), and catastrophic rm -rf (/, ~, $HOME, ., system dirs). Non-bash tools are untouched.
